claimTtlSeconds.description: Default lease lifetime in seconds for issue.claim and issue.renew when input.ttlSeconds is omitted. An explicit input duration overrides this value.

labelOrder.description: Labels in rank order, first ranks highest (for example p0, p1, p2). issue.ready sorts an item by the first of these labels it carries; items with none come last, and ties keep their stored order. Left empty, issue.ready does not reorder.

idPrefix.description: The prefix new issue ids carry, as in <idPrefix>-<n>. Derived from the project: the origin remote's repository name, or the main checkout's folder name when Git is unavailable or no origin is configured, normalised to lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. A failed origin lookup refuses a work operation only when the project has no explicit idPrefix; other calls omit the failed derived observation: transient failures may be retried; permanent failures require correcting the reported Git error. Every item is shown with the current prefix; an id with a prefix this project minted with earlier (work-12 after a change to acme) still names the same item, and any other prefix is refused.

discardIgnored.description: Ignored paths safe to discard when removing a clean lane. A trailing slash matches a directory prefix.

base.description: Origin branch to fetch. Omitted: origin HEAD, falling back to main.
